title: CLARITY Act Likely Dead Until 2027, Top Crypto Lawmakers Warn
summary: Bitcoin Magazine CLARITY Act Likely Dead Until 2027, Top Crypto Lawmakers Warn House Financial Services Chairman French Hill said the CLARITY Act's chances in the lame-duck session are "not high," pushing the crypto market structure bill toward a Democratic-led Congress. This post CLARITY Act Likely Dead Until 2027, Top Crypto Lawmakers Warn first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
